title: Rho founder quotes
description: A 60px heading over a three-by-two grid of flat tinted cards: a 20px quote at the top and, pinned to the bottom, a small square avatar with a name and an optional handle. Cards fade up one after another; on phones the grid becomes a sideways rail with arrows.
notes: avatar: a 40px image per quote; empty: initials on a muted square
needs JavaScript for the phone rail's arrows (hydrate: visible)
